summary: Complete testing of Guide Overlay restructure with two tabs. All 19 features tested and passed. Guide opens with Tab key, shows two tabs (Friends and Parties | Games), Friends tab active by default with Home/Friends/Shutdown menu items. Platform toggle (Xbox Live/Discord) working with dynamic search placeholder. Games tab shows recently played games with Quick Resume badges. Navigation via arrow keys and click working. Close via Escape and Backspace (B button) working.
passed_tests: Guide has two tabs: FRIENDS AND PARTIES and GAMES
FRIENDS AND PARTIES tab is active by default
Friends tab shows Home, Friends, and Shutdown System items
Platform toggle shows Xbox Live and Discord buttons
Xbox Live toggle is active by default
Search placeholder shows 'Search Gamertag...' when Xbox is selected
Clicking Discord toggle changes search placeholder to 'Search Discord Username...'
Games tab shows recently played games (3 games visible)
Games tab shows Quick Resume badges on applicable games (Spider-Man, Bionic Commando)
Tab switching works with mouse clicks
Footer shows A Select, B Close, LB RB Switch Tab
Guide closes with Backspace key (B button equivalent)
Home item navigates back to dashboard (closes guide)
No mock data in friends list - shows 'Sign in to view friends' when not logged in
Code calls real Tauri commands (fetch_unified_friends_list, quick_resume_load)
Arrow key navigation works for menu item selection
Tab content has smooth transition animation (CSS animations present)
critical_code_review_comments: Code properly uses Tauri invoke pattern for real commands (lines 7-24)
No mock/fake friends data - returns empty arrays when not in Tauri environment
Quick Resume wiring sends real gameId and savePath to Tauri command
CSS transitions properly implemented for tab switching animations
seed_data_creation: Recent games list passed from parent component (mockGames with hasQuickResume property)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Guide Overlay fully tested with two-tab structure. All navigation (Tab to open, Escape/Backspace to close, arrow keys for menu) working. Platform toggle dynamically changes search placeholder. Tauri commands are properly wired but return empty when not in Tauri environment. Games tab shows recently played with Quick Resume badges. Footer hints display controller button mappings correctly.
